  SELECT T1."XCL_069" AS race_name,
    (CAST(SUBSTR(T2."XCL_088",1,INSTR(T2."XCL_088",':')-1) AS REAL)*60)

    + (CAST(SUBSTR(T2."XCL_088",INSTR(T2."XCL_088",".")+1) AS REAL)/1000) AS secs
  FROM races AS T1
  JOIN results AS T2 ON T2."XCL_074"=T1."XCL_065"
  JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3."XCL_034"=T2."XCL_075"
  JOIN circuits AS T4 ON T4."XCL_001"=T1."XCL_068"
  WHERE T3."XCL_038"='Lewis' AND T3."XCL_039"='Hamilton'
    AND T4."XCL_005"!='Italy' AND T2."XCL_088" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT race_name FROM flt ORDER BY secs ASC LIMIT 1
